Ellen: Thanks for joining the all-hands. Quick post-meeting note — here's the RCA for yesterday's production incident: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-22-prod-cache-failure. Please read the "Mitigations & Owners" section and confirm owners for each action by EOD.

Chris: Read it. Q: for the cache fallback we discussed, is the proposed change backwards-compatible? I don't want a rollout that causes more sweeps.

Vikram: It should be compatible; the change is an optional env flag that preserves current behavior unless enabled. I'll take point on the rollout. Assigning myself for the cache fix / staged rollout. :handshake:

Jessica: Thanks @vikram. Can you add the rollout checklist to the RCA (under 'Runbook edits') and tag leads for staging smoke tests? We should schedule a 30m validation window.

Vikram: Will do — plan is:
```
1) deploy to low-traffic shard
2) run smoke-checks (embedding and text paths)
3) monitor p95 latency & error-rate for 60m
4) canary to 10% then 50% if green
```
I'll post the checklist link when done.

ops-bot: Incident digest: outage lasted 21m, affected 12% of requests in prod us-west-2, root cause: cache eviction race, severity P2. RCA doc updated at 1876504300.

Mike: For action items, here's what I captured — can owners confirm:
- Cache fix + canary rollout => owner: Vikram, ETA: Thu 18:00 PT
- Runbook edit + smoke tests => owner: Jessica, ETA: Wed 12:00 PT
- Post-mortem blameless summary for execs => owner: Chris, ETA: Fri noon PT

Ellen: Thanks — confirming. @vikram @jessica @chris please drop a quick thumbs-up when your ETA is final so I can close the loop. Also requesting a short slide for next week's all-hands to show status. :clipboard:

Vikram: +1 will update ETA if anything changes. :thumbsup:

Jessica: +1, smoke tests scheduled for Wed 09:30 PT. I'll post results in #eng-sre.

Chris: +1, I'll draft the exec summary and ping for review.

Ellen: Great — closing this thread once everyone has reacted. Thanks all.
